  contenu: ""

geometry: margin=1.6cm

    \makeatletter
    \renewcommand\paragraph{\@startsection{paragraph}{4}{\z@}{3.25ex \@plus 1ex \@minus .2ex}{1ex \@plus .2ex}{\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries}}
    \makeatother

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(system.file("modeles", "entete.R", package = "eduschool"), local = TRUE)
.entete_edu(list(support = "divers", titre = params$titre),
            knitr::is_html_output())
```

```{r sommaire_pdf, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  cat("```{=latex}\n\\setcounter{tocdepth}{5}\n\\tableofcontents\n\\clearpage\n```\n")
}
```

```{r contenu, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(params$contenu, "\n")
```
